title: Curatorial Design and Composition
goal: Describe gallery layout, lighting, and artistic composition with estar + participle in contrast with ser + participle for historical creation or restoration.
grammar: estar + participle for curatorial layout and composition vs ser + participle for historical creation and restoration

items: I can describe gallery layout, lighting, and visual composition with estar + past participle.
I can contrast current curatorial state (estar) with historical creation or restoration (ser + participle).
I can use curation and studio vocabulary (la curaduría, el boceto, el lienzo, la instalación, la iluminación, articular, restaurar).
